The '''Tovosh system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] that was located within the [[Oricho sector/Legends|Oricho sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]], that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Pleida]].
